title: agent.command_event payload v2
description: Reported by the Agent as it progresses through a command: acknowledged when received, running once execution starts, then exactly one of succeeded/failed/timed_out. Multiple events are sent per command (a full history is kept in agent_command_events).

result.description: Command-type-specific structured result, set on succeeded.

error.description: Human-readable failure reason, set on failed.
